title: Profile cosmetics: frame overlay, badge display, theme backgrounds + set streak freezer cost to 50 coins

requirements.text: Change the Streak Freeze price to 50 coins everywhere it is enforced and displayed (backend purchase validation and all frontend UI text).

quotes: ALSO THE STREAK FREEZER COST 50 COINS

acceptanceCriteria: Attempting to purchase a streak freeze with < 50 coins fails with an error message mentioning 50 coins.
Attempting to purchase a streak freeze with >= 50 coins succeeds (assuming other backend validations pass).
The Timer section UI shows the cost as 50 coins (including the call-to-action button label and any helper text).
The backend constant/value used for streak freeze cost is 50 (no remaining hard-coded 100s for this feature).

requirements.text: Update the Profile avatar rendering so that when a user has an unlocked/selected frame, the frame visually overlays and covers the circumference of the profile photo (a ring/frame sitting on top of the circular avatar edge, not behind it).

quotes: frame unlocked will cover profile photo's circumferance by the frame.

acceptanceCriteria: When a user has a profile image, the frame is rendered as an overlay on top of the avatar and visibly frames the circular edge.
When a user has no profile image (fallback initials), the frame still overlays the circular avatar container.
If no frame is owned/selected, the avatar renders exactly as it did before (no empty overlay artifacts).

requirements.text: Display purchased/earned badges on the user profile, including badges earned via streak milestones and badges purchased with coins.

quotes: also the badges purchased by streak and coins will display on profile

acceptanceCriteria: The Profile section shows a dedicated badges area/list/grid.
Streak milestone badge(s) (based on existing streak badge tier/state) appear in the Profile badges area when earned.
Coin-purchased badge(s) appear in the Profile badges area after purchase.
Badges shown on the profile persist across reloads/logins for the same user.

requirements.text: Make purchased themes apply as the app background (global app background), using the user's currently selected purchased theme.

quotes: purchased themes will be as background of the app.

acceptanceCriteria: After selecting a purchased theme, the app background changes (not just inside the Background Settings UI).
The selected background persists across reloads/logins for the same user.
If the user has no selected theme/background, the app uses the default background styling (no broken/missing background).

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional canisters/services).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any frontend immutablePaths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT; compose them instead.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Do not add third-party authentication (only Internet Identity).
Do not redesign unrelated sections (tasks/notes/timetable) beyond what is required to support cosmetics display and backgrounds.
